system.description:
Range: Self

You conduct a ritual to copy the face and appearance of a once-living person, stealing their voice and appearance.

You must spend at least one minute observing an adjacent creature. If it is dead, it must have died within the last day.

Once the ritual is complete, your voice and physical features transmute to make you look and sound identical to the creature.

The transformation lasts for a number of hours equal to your Soul.

If observers have no reason to doubt your identity, you have Greater Advantage on checks to pass as the creature you are impersonating.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.qNwkQ0F9pxUTx8ML]{Fox Mask}
